profiles.shortDescription: Bender develops electrical-safety monitoring equipment for unearthed and earthed power systems. Its official portfolio covers insulation and residual-current monitoring, fault-location systems, measuring relays, power quality, medical IT systems and electrical test equipment.
fullDescription: Bender GmbH & Co. KG is a German electrical-safety technology manufacturer. The official product range includes ISOMETER insulation-monitoring devices, insulation fault-location systems, residual-current and neutral-grounding-resistance monitoring, measuring and monitoring relays, power-quality equipment, communication panels, medical isolated-power systems and test engineering. These products support industrial plants, energy systems, rail, electric vehicles and healthcare installations.

profiles.shortDescription: IMA Benhil develops dosing, wrapping and secondary-packaging equipment for butter, margarine, edible fats and other pasty foods. Its official portfolio includes consumer and large-portion wrapping machines, tub fillers and Cartomat wrap-around cartoners.
fullDescription: IMA Benhil is an IMA Group food-and-dairy equipment brand with more than a century of documented packaging experience. Its official offering includes dosing and wrapping machines for butter, margarine, edible fats and other pasty products, equipment for consumer packs and larger portions, tub-filling systems and Cartomat secondary-packaging machines. Current product families include Multipack and FoldWrap platforms for primary packaging.

profiles.shortDescription: Benier is the former name of Royal Kaak's Kaak Dough Technology business. The operation develops bakery dough-processing systems including mixers, dividers, rounders, proofers, moulders and DrieM sheeting lines.
fullDescription: Benier Nederland B.V. has operated as Kaak Dough Technology since 2021 and remains part of Royal Kaak. Based in Nieuwkuijk, the business develops dough make-up equipment for industrial bakeries. Its official range includes mixers, dough dividers, rounders, proofers and moulders, together with DrieM sheeting systems for bread, rolls, baguettes, panettone, pizza and other dough products.

profiles.shortDescription: Bently Nevada is a Baker Hughes business for machinery protection, condition monitoring and asset-performance management. Its portfolio combines industrial sensors, monitoring systems, diagnostic software and connected analytics for rotating and heavy equipment.
fullDescription: Bently Nevada is Baker Hughes' machinery condition-monitoring and protection business. The official portfolio includes vibration, proximity and other industrial sensors, continuous monitoring and machinery-protection platforms, portable data acquisition, diagnostic software and connected asset-performance applications. Systems such as 3500, Orbit 60 and System 1 support motors, generators, turbines, compressors, pumps, gearboxes and other critical machinery.

profiles.shortDescription: BERU is an automotive ignition and diesel cold-start technology brand. Its official range covers glow plugs, pressure-sensor glow plugs, glow-control units, spark plugs, ignition coils and selected engine sensors.
fullDescription: BERU is a registered BorgWarner trademark used for automotive ignition and diesel cold-start technologies. Official BERU material covers metal and ceramic glow plugs, pressure-sensor glow plugs, glow-control units and relays, spark plugs, ignition coils, ignition leads and selected lambda, speed, temperature and pressure sensors. The products support diesel cold starting, combustion monitoring and petrol-engine ignition systems.

profiles.officialName: BHS Corrugated Maschinen- und Anlagenbau GmbH
profiles.shortDescription: BHS Corrugated develops machinery, complete corrugator lines and digital systems for corrugated-board production. Its portfolio includes corrugators, individual machines, corrugating rolls, digital printing, intralogistics, automation and lifecycle services.
fullDescription: BHS Corrugated Maschinen- und Anlagenbau GmbH is a German machinery and plant-engineering company headquartered in Weiherhammer. Its official portfolio covers complete corrugator lines, individual corrugating machines, corrugating rolls, single-pass digital printing, intralogistics and data-based automation for corrugated-board plants. BHS Corrugated also provides parts, upgrades, digital services and lifecycle agreements for installed production equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: bielomatik develops customized plastic-joining machines and automated production lines. Its technologies include hot-plate, infrared, vibration, laser, ultrasonic, thermal-contact and high-frequency welding for automotive, medical, electrical and consumer-product applications.
fullDescription: bielomatik GmbH is a German machinery company based in Römerstein and owned by Persico Holding. The company develops customized systems for joining plastic components, from individual machines to automated production lines. Its official technology portfolio includes hot-plate, infrared, vibration, laser, two-step laser, ultrasonic, thermal-contact and high-frequency welding, with automation, component handling, machining, assembly and testing integrated where required.

profiles.shortDescription: BIERI develops high-pressure hydraulic pumps, valves and compact systems. Its official range includes piston and combination pumps, directional, pressure, flow and check valves, manual valves, connecting plates and application-specific hydraulic solutions.
fullDescription: BIERI Hydraulik AG is a Swiss high-pressure hydraulics manufacturer and a member of the HYDAC Group. Its official portfolio includes axial and radial piston pumps, combination pumps, directional poppet and cartridge valves, pressure-relief and reducing valves, flow-control and check valves, manual spool valves, connecting plates and accessories. Components are documented for compact hydraulic systems with operating pressures reaching 1,000 bar in selected ranges.

profiles.shortDescription: Biesse manufactures production lines, machines and components for processing wood, glass, stone, composite materials and metal. Its portfolio covers cutting, drilling, milling, edging, polishing, waterjet and multi-process equipment.
fullDescription: Biesse S.p.A. is an Italian machinery manufacturer headquartered in Pesaro. The company develops production lines, machines and components for transforming wood, glass, natural and engineered stone, composite materials and metal. Its official machining capabilities include cutting, drilling, milling, edging, polishing, sanding, waterjet processing and integrated multi-process solutions, supported by software, automation and lifecycle services.

profiles.shortDescription: Bifold is a Rotork brand for hydraulic, pneumatic and high-pressure instrumentation valves and control products. Its range covers solenoid, pilot, mechanical, ball, needle, check, flow-control and pressure-sensing valves, manifolds and valve controllers.
fullDescription: Bifold is part of Rotork's instrumentation and fluid-control portfolio. The official product range includes pneumatic and hydraulic solenoid valves, pilot and mechanical valves, ball and needle valves, check and shuttle valves, flow and pressure-control products, manifold solutions and diagnostic or modulating valve controllers. Selected Bifold configurations are engineered for high-pressure, hazardous-area, fire-safe and subsea duties.

profiles.shortDescription: Bihl+Wiedemann develops AS-Interface automation and functional-safety equipment. Its portfolio includes ASi masters and gateways, I/O and safety modules, safety monitors, bus couplers, master simulators, accessories and configuration software.
fullDescription: Bihl+Wiedemann GmbH is a German automation company founded in Mannheim in 1992. The manufacturer specializes in AS-Interface communication and functional safety for machines and plants. Its official portfolio includes ASi-5 and ASi-3 masters and gateways, standard and safety I/O modules, safety monitors, bus couplers, master simulators, motor-control modules, network accessories and ASIMON or ASi Control Tools software.

profiles.shortDescription: Bimba develops pneumatic, hydraulic, electric and vacuum motion-control components. Its official range covers linear and rotary actuators, cylinders, valves, air preparation, grippers, manifolds, sensors, vacuum products and fittings.
fullDescription: Bimba LLC is an IMI motion-control business based in University Park, Illinois. The official portfolio includes pneumatic round-line, compact, NFPA, rodless and rotary actuators, hydraulic cylinders, electric motion products, valves, air-preparation equipment, grippers, manifolds, sensors, vacuum components, fittings and tubing. These products support automation in automotive, food and packaging, medical, agriculture and general industrial applications.

profiles.officialName: Blickle Räder+Rollen GmbH u. Co. KG
profiles.shortDescription: Blickle manufactures industrial wheels, castors and electric drive systems for mobile equipment and material handling. Its range includes swivel, fixed, heavy-duty, stainless-steel, levelling and twin-wheel castors, guide rollers and pallet-truck wheels.
fullDescription: Blickle Räder+Rollen GmbH u. Co. KG is a German wheel and castor manufacturer headquartered in Rosenfeld. Its official standard range covers swivel and fixed castors, wheels and guide rollers, heavy-duty and stainless-steel castors, levelling and twin-wheel designs, drive wheels, flanged wheels and rollers for pallet or forklift trucks. Blickle also develops ErgoMove electric drive systems and customized mobility solutions for intralogistics, conveyor equipment, machines and medical devices.
